summary.intent: Execute all 7 plans for Phase 21 (BYO IPFS Node Support) using wave-based parallel execution, including SDK pinning abstractions, API endpoints, Settings UI, TEE migration backend, and progress UI. Perform UAT via Playwright to verify the full migration flow end-to-end.
summary.outcome: All 7 plans executed and committed. Six bugs were found and fixed during Playwright UAT. Migration from CipherBox to external Kubo was fully verified (44/44 CIDs). Four gap closure plans (21-08 through 21-11) were created to address dual-pin upload wiring, TEE-routed connection test, Pinata support, and benchmark baselines.

repo: The TEE worker does not auto-load .env files — env vars must be passed inline (e.g. `TEE_WORKER_SECRET=x tsx watch src/index.ts`) or via the shell environment
The migration processor used `TEE_AUTH_SECRET` while the TeeService used `TEE_WORKER_SECRET` — the two services had diverged env var names for the same secret
StorageTab encrypts provider configs with ECIES and serializes via `bytesToHex`, but migration-worker.ts decoded with `Buffer.from(..., 'base64')` — hex/base64 mismatch silently corrupted ciphertext
The migration trigger requires `savedConfig !== null`, but first-time users switching from the default 'cipherbox' mode have no IPNS record, so `savedConfig` is always null and migration never fires
The SSRF protection in migration-worker.ts blocks `192.168.*` and `10.*` ranges, which prevents local dev testing against Docker-hosted Kubo nodes; simulator mode now bypasses this
The `cipherbox` protocol type was missing from the TEE migration worker's provider config parser — migrating FROM cipherbox required a dedicated fetch path using the CipherBox IPFS gateway URL
Pinata deprecated their standard PSA endpoint (`/psa`) — it returns 404; their current API is proprietary (`/v3/files`) and not compatible with the PsaProvider
Filebase's IPFS RPC endpoint (`rpc.filebase.io`) returns an HTML error page for `/api/v0/id` rather than a valid Kubo RPC response
DualPinProvider exists in the SDK but the web app's upload pipeline does not invoke it — dual-write config is saved correctly but secondary pin never fires during upload
Migration is implemented as copy-only; there is no unpin-from-source step after successful CID integrity verification
The QEMU VM running the dev session cannot access the host via `192.168.133.114` after a Docker stack restart because DHCP reassigned the host to `192.168.133.12`
The API auth store is memory-only — auth state cannot be injected via localStorage for Playwright testing; full UI login flow is required
Calling the test-login API endpoint for an email, then attempting email OTP login with the same address, causes a duplicate key constraint on `UQ_auth_methods_type_hash`
pnpm dev uses Nest watch mode which hot-reloads on file changes, but the reloaded process fails with EADDRINUSE if the original process still holds the port — requires explicit kill before restart

code.finding: Kubo and PSA probes treated any non-200 status as 'endpoint not detected' — 401/403/422 responses (endpoint found, auth failed) now recognized separately and reported as authentication failures rather than protocol detection failures

Migration trigger condition `savedConfig && (mode changed) && usedBytes > 0` was never satisfied for first-time users because `savedConfig` is null (no IPNS record). Fixed to treat null savedConfig as implicit 'cipherbox' mode so the condition evaluates correctly on first provider switch
Processor checked `process.env.TEE_AUTH_SECRET` but the project-wide env var is `TEE_WORKER_SECRET` — caused processor to always throw 'not configured' error before any migration work

Multiple issues: (1) ECIES decryption used base64 decode but ciphertext was hex-encoded — fixed to hex; (2) SSRF validation blocked RFC-1918 addresses preventing local dev; (3) missing 'cipherbox' protocol type caused parse failure when migrating from default CipherBox storage; (4) no cipherbox-protocol fetch path (needed to pull from CipherBox IPFS gateway)

workflow: OTP codes logged by the API can be read from background task output files in `/private/tmp/claude-501/...` rather than requiring the user to copy from their terminal

When pnpm dev hot-reload fails with EADDRINUSE, the fix is to kill processes on the port explicitly (`kill $(lsof -ti:3000)`) before starting fresh — hot-reload does not reliably replace the old process

BullMQ retains failed job state in Redis across API restarts — stale failed migrations show up in polling and can confuse the UI; triggering a new migration requires switching modes so the service creates a new job rather than checking for an existing one

For Playwright E2E tests that require real auth, the wallet mock path (EIP-6963 mock wallet) is the primary tested path; email OTP works for one-time login but conflicts with test-login API if the same email is used
Testing SaaS IPFS providers (Pinata, Filebase) from the browser is blocked by CORS; even the connection test cannot reach these APIs without a server-side or TEE-side proxy

friction: DHCP reassigned the host IP from 192.168.133.114 to 192.168.133.12 after Docker stack restart, requiring manual .env update across 5 entries before any services could start
TEE worker silently ignores .env files — the missing env vars caused HTTP 500 on the public key endpoint with no clear error until the auth middleware was read directly
Pinata's PSA endpoint deprecation (404) was only discovered during live testing — the connection test reported 'could not detect protocol' with no indication the endpoint is gone
Filebase's non-standard RPC auth (returns HTML error pages) made it impossible to test with their platform despite following documented setup steps
pnpm dev hot-reload left the old process holding port 3000, so the TEE env var fix (TEE_AUTH_SECRET → TEE_WORKER_SECRET) never took effect across two restart attempts until ports were killed manually
BullMQ consumed the old failed migration jobs on API restart before the fix was applied — required multiple mode-switching cycles to trigger a clean migration attempt
Playwright page crashed uploading 100MB of files in one operation — had to split into multiple sequential uploads
The auth store being memory-only with no test bypass in the web app meant full OTP login was required for every new Playwright session, including after page crashes
open_items: Plan 21-08: Wire BYO config into SDK client lifecycle and add source unpin step after successful migration — DualPinProvider exists but web upload does not invoke secondary pin
Plan 21-09: Move connection test from browser-side to TEE-routed (POST /connection-test with ECIES-wrapped config) to eliminate CORS issues with SaaS providers and maintain zero-knowledge property
Plan 21-10: Implement PinataProvider for Pinata's proprietary /v3/files API since their PSA endpoint is deprecated

Plan 21-11: Run BYO performance benchmarks against real external IPFS provider and capture baselines in .planning/baselines/21-byo-baselines.md — deferred because provider infrastructure was not available during execution
Reverse migration (external → cipherbox) had 1/45 CID failure — likely a CID version mismatch (v0 vs v1); root cause not investigated

MigrationProgress component shows stale failed migration status after a new successful migration completes — polling returns the last completed job regardless of success/failure; needs to filter or order by recency

VERIFICATION.md human verification items (Settings tab rendering, CORS instructions display, advisory badge, migration polling) were verified via Playwright but not formally recorded as passed in the verification document
